classSiblings.label: L-04 (run-22, open)
classSiblings.title: Kendu is whitelisted unconditionally while its BLOCKING fee-on-transfer probe is PREVIEW-only
classSiblings.relationship: Same family: a blocking probe that only executes on the preview path. NOT a duplicate.
classSiblings.whyNotMerged: Opposite positions in the sequence, therefore no single relocation serves both. L-04's probe is a PREFLIGHT — it must run BEFORE the whitelist decision, i.e. earlier on the broadcast path. F-01's probe is a POST-MINT VERIFICATION — it must run AFTER the cutover has landed, i.e. in a post-broadcast read-only leg. Moving Phase 8 onto the broadcast path (F-01's fix) does not put the Kendu FoT probe ahead of the whitelist write; gating the whitelist on the FoT probe (L-04's fix) does not exercise a post-cutover index-4 mint. Different probes, different functions, different consumers, separate mitigations. Fails the fix-for-A-fixes-B test in both directions.
classSiblings.instructionCompliance: The task's do-not-re-mint list names the Kendu FoT preview-only issue as already reconciled to L-04. F-01 does not re-mint it: F-01 is about BalancerPoolerV2._psmDonate's swallowed try/catch failure and the _probePoolerDonation smoke test, and mentions Kendu nowhere.
